name: Land Rover
overview: The backbone of Australian outback exploration, military transport, and luxury off-roading, with extensive local assembly at Enfield and Moorebank NSW including the iconic Australian Army Perentie 4x4 and 6x6.
australian_history: Land Rover arrived in Australia in 1949 with early Series I models deployed on the monumental Snowy Mountains Hydro-Electric Scheme, where their indestructible four-wheel drive capability established their reputation. To meet high demand and local content rules, Pressed Metal Corporation (PMC) in Enfield, Sydney began assembling CKD kits in 1956. By the 1970s and 1980s, Jaguar Rover Australia (JRA) in Moorebank, NSW was manufacturing Australian-specific Land Rovers, notably fitting the local 3.5L Rover V8 and Australian-exclusive Isuzu 4BD1 3.9-litre four-cylinder diesel engine into civilian County 110s. In the late 1980s, JRA won the Australian Army's Project Perentie contract, designing and building over 3,700 military-spec 4x4 and wide-cab 6x6 Land Rovers with galvanized chassis, leaf-spring rocker suspension, and Isuzu diesel power. Today, Land Rover Australia thrives with the modern Defender (L663), Discovery, and Range Rover luxury sub-brands.

models.name: Defender
models.overview: The immortal off-road master of the Australian bush and Australian Defence Force. Built and adapted locally with unique Australian military specifications (Project Perentie 4x4 and 6x6 with Isuzu 4BD1 3.9L engines), live-axle County 110s, and re-imagined for the 21st century as the ultra-capable, luxury L663 Defender.

Built and adapted locally with unique Australian military specifications (Project Perentie 4x4 and 6x6 with Isuzu 4BD1 3.9L engines), live-axle County 110s, and re-imagined for the 21st century as the ultra-capable, luxury L663 Defender.
defender.australian_market_notes: Originally imported for the Snowy Mountains Scheme in 1949. Local assembly by Pressed Metal Corp and JRA in Sydney produced Australian-exclusive variants, notably the Australian Army Perentie 4x4 and 6x6. Civil models adopted the 300Tdi, 5-cylinder Td5, and Ford Puma 2.4/2.2 TDCi until original production concluded in 2016. The all-new aluminium D7x monocoque L663 launched in 2020.

range-rover-discovery.name: Range Rover & Discovery
range-rover-discovery.overview: The twin benchmarks of British luxury and all-terrain expedition mastery in Australia. The Range Rover created the luxury 4WD genre in 1972, proving that supreme off-road capability could coexist with peerless aristocratic comfort. The Land Rover Discovery launched in Australia in 1991, democratizing Range Rover technology into an iconic stepped-roof, 7-seat family adventurer.
range-rover-discovery.australian_market_notes: First imported to Australia in 1972 with the 2-door Range Rover Classic. It quickly proved itself indispensable across pastoral stations and remote outback expeditions. Discovery 1 & 2 became beloved overland tourers, while Discovery 3 & 4 with Terrain Response and 3500kg towing became Australia's premier luxury caravan hauler.
